wrap;">registrations:<br> - endpoint: v1/get_user_info<br> type: "custom"<br> metadata:<br> name: "user_custom_query"<br> description: "query all the info from user"<br> table_name: "users"<br> created_by: "developer@example.com"<br><br> query:<br> sql: |<br> SELECT<br> id,<br> username,<br> email,<br> status,<br> created_at,<br> updated_at<br> FROM users<br> WHERE<br> (:status IS NULL OR status = :status)<br> AND (:email_pattern IS NULL OR email LIKE :email_pattern)<br> AND created_at &gt;= COALESCE(:min_created_at, '2020-01-01')<br> ORDER BY created_at DESC<br> LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset<br><br> engine: "TRINO"<br><br> parameters:<br> - name: "status"<br> type: "STRING"<br> required: false<br> description: "user status filter"<br><br> - name: "email_pattern"<br> type: "STRING"<br> required: false<br> description: "user email"<br> default: "%@example.com"<br><br> - name: "min_created_at"<br> type: "DATE"<br> required: false<br><br> - name: "limit"<br> type: "INTEGER"<br> required: true<br> default: 100<br><br> - name: "offset"<br> type: "INTEGER"<br> required: true<br> default: 0<br><br> result_mapping:<br> - source_column: "id"<br> target_field: "userId"<br> field_type: "ID"<br> description: "user ID"<br><br> - source_column: "username"<br> target_field: "name"<br> field_type: "STRING"<br><br> - source_column: "email"<br> target_field: "email"<br> field_type: "STRING"<br><br> - source_column: "status"<br> target_field: "status"<br> field_type: "STRING"<br><br> - source_column: "created_at"<br> target_field: "createTime"<br> field_type: "DATETIME"<br> transformation_type: "FORMAT"<br> transformation_expression: "TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')"<br><br> graphql:<br> operation_type: "QUERY"<br> requires_authentication: true<br> rate_limit_per_hour: 1000<br> max_rows_per_request: 100<br> timeout_ms: 30000</span></font><font face="var(--ds-font-family-code)" color="rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"><span width="350" height="1520" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Sj056u9HCvxDQYYd9y3G-8" value="<div>CREATE TABLE simple_table_registry (</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; table_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; datasource_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TRINO',</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; catalog_name VARCHAR(100),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; schema_name VARCHAR(100),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; description TEXT,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; business_owner VARCHAR(100),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; technical_owner VARCHAR(100),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; endpoint varchar(200)</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; is_sensitive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; registration_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (registration_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'DEPRECATED')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL</div><div>);</div><div><br></div>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="390" y="310" width="480" height="305" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Sj056u9HCvxDQYYd9y3G-10" value="<div><div>CREATE TABLE codegen_tasks (</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; task_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; table_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES table_registry(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; schema_version INT NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; task_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (task_type IN ('INITIAL', 'SCHEMA_CHANGE', 'CONFIG_CHANGE', 'MANUAL_TRIGGER')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; trigger_source VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (trigger_source IN ('API', 'SCHEDULED', 'WEBHOOK', 'MANUAL')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; priority INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 50</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (priority BETWEEN 0 AND 100),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; requested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; started_at TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; completed_at TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; processed_by VARCHAR(100),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; timeout_seconds INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 300,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; current_retry_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; max_retry_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; UNIQUE(table_id, schema_version, task_type)</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')</div><div>);</div></div><div><br></div>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1001" y="320" width="480" height="430" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Sj056u9HCvxDQYYd9y3G-11" value="record the tasks status every day" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="990" y="280" width="240" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Sj056u9HCvxDQYYd9y3G-12" value="<div><div><div>CREATE TABLE codegen_task_details (</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; detail_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; task_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES codegen_tasks(task_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; generation_target VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (generation_target IN ('TYPE_DEF', 'RESOLVER', 'DATA_FETCHER', 'SCHEMA', 'ALL')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; artifact_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (artifact_type IN ('GRAPHQL', 'JAVA', 'KOTLIN', 'SCALA')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; source_template VARCHAR(100),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; output_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; start_time TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; end_time TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; error_message TEXT,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; artifact_content_hash VARCHAR(64),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; generated_artifact_path VARCHAR(500)</div><div>);</div></div></div>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1550" y="300" width="480" height="430" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Sj056u9HCvxDQYYd9y3G-13" value="<div>CREATE TABLE codegen_artifacts (</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; artifact_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; table_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES table_registry(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; version_tag VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; task_id BIGINT REFERENCES codegen_tasks(task_id),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; artifact_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (artifact_type IN ('TYPE_DEF', 'RESOLVER', 'DATA_FETCHER', 'SCHEMA')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; artifact_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; is_current BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; generated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; generated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; UNIQUE(table_id, version_tag, artifact_type, artifact_path)</div><div>);</div><div><br></div><div>CREATE INDEX idx_codegen_artifacts_current ON codegen_artifacts(table_id, is_current);</div><div><br></div><div><br></div><div><br></div><div>CREATE TABLE task_execution_logs (</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; log_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; task_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES codegen_tasks(task_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; log_level VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (log_level IN ('DEBUG', 'INFO', 'WARN', 'ERROR', 'FATAL')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; log_message TEXT NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; log_context JSONB,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP</div><div>);</div><div><br></div><div>CREATE INDEX idx_task_execution_logs_task ON task_execution_logs(task_id);</div><div>CREATE INDEX idx_task_execution_logs_time ON task_execution_logs(created_at);</div>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="2090" y="320" width="480" height="550" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Sj056u9HCvxDQYYd9y3G-14" value="<div><div>CREATE TABLE custom_queries (</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; query_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; query_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; table_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES table_registry(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; description TEXT,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; sql_template TEXT NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; endpoint VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; sql_engine VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TRINO'</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (sql_engine IN ('TRINO', 'POSTGRES', 'MYSQL', 'GENERIC')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; cache_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; cache_ttl_seconds INT DEFAULT 300,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; created_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; updated_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL</div><div>);</div></div>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="390" y="680" width="480" height="305" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Sj056u9HCvxDQYYd9y3G-15" value="<div>CREATE TABLE query_parameters (</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; param_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; query_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES custom_queries(query_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; param_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; param_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (param_type IN ('STRING', 'INTEGER', 'FLOAT', 'BOOLEAN', 'DATE', 'TIMESTAMP')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; is_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; default_value VARCHAR(500),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; validation_regex VARCHAR(500),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; description TEXT,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; UNIQUE(query_id, param_name)</div><div>);</div><div><br></div><div>CREATE INDEX idx_query_params_query ON query_parameters(query_id);</div><div>CREATE INDEX idx_query_params_name ON query_parameters(param_name);</div><div><br></div><div>CREATE TABLE result_mappings (</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; mapping_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; query_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES custom_queries(query_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; source_column VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; target_field VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; field_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (field_type IN ('ID', 'STRING', 'INT', 'FLOAT', 'BOOLEAN', 'DATE', 'DATETIME', 'JSON')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; transformation_type VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'DIRECT'</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CHECK (transformation_type IN ('DIRECT', 'FORMAT', 'CALCULATION', 'CUSTOM_FUNCTION')),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; transformation_expression TEXT,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; is_nullable BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; default_value VARCHAR(500),</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; description TEXT,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; sort_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp; UNIQUE(query_id, target_field)</div><div>);</div><div><br></div><div>CREATE INDEX idx_result_mapping_query ON result_mappings(query_id);</div><div>CREATE INDEX idx_result_mapping_source ON result_mappings(source_column);</div>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;" font.span:
registrations:
- endpoint: v1/get_user_info
type: "custom"
metadata:
name: "user_custom_query"
description: "query all the info from user"
table_name: "users"
created_by: "developer@example.com"
query:
sql: |
SELECT
id,
username,
email,
status,
created_at,
updated_at
FROM users
WHERE
(:status IS NULL OR status = :status)
AND (:email_pattern IS NULL OR email LIKE :email_pattern)
AND created_at >= COALESCE(:min_created_at, '2020-01-01')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
engine: "TRINO"
parameters:
- name: "status"
type: "STRING"
required: false
description: "user status filter"
- name: "email_pattern"
type: "STRING"
required: false
description: "user email"
default: "%@example.com"
- name: "min_created_at"
type: "DATE"
required: false
- name: "limit"
type: "INTEGER"
required: true
default: 100
- name: "offset"
type: "INTEGER"
required: true
default: 0
result_mapping:
- source_column: "id"
target_field: "userId"
field_type: "ID"
description: "user ID"
- source_column: "username"
target_field: "name"
field_type: "STRING"
- source_column: "email"
target_field: "email"
field_type: "STRING"
- source_column: "status"
target_field: "status"
field_type: "STRING"
- source_column: "created_at"
target_field: "createTime"
field_type: "DATETIME"
transformation_type: "FORMAT"
transformation_expression: "TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')"
graphql:
operation_type: "QUERY"
requires_authentication: true
rate_limit_per_hour: 1000
max_rows_per_request: 100
timeout_ms: 30000
